name: Nuki Smart Lock 4th Gen (EU)

radios.note: Nuki's generations table lists no built-in Wi-Fi for the standard model. The latest CSA entry text mentions Wi-Fi, so the verifier should check it. The Pro model is not recorded here.

matter.note: Several CSA entries exist for the 4th generation lock (vendor ID 0x135D, product ID 0x00B0).

apple_home.note: Nuki lists Apple Home for Matter over Thread. A Thread border router (HomePod mini, Apple TV 4K) is needed.

google_home.note: Nuki Web cloud integration, which needs remote access (Nuki Bridge or the paid Thread remote-access option). Matter via Thread is also supported and needs a Thread border router.

alexa.note: Nuki Web cloud integration, which needs remote access. Matter is also supported, but Nuki's hub table lists only the Echo (4th Gen) for Matter via Thread.

smartthings.note: Nuki lists Samsung SmartThings as a Matter hub. A Thread border router is needed.

home_assistant.note: Nuki lists Home Assistant for Matter via Thread. Home Assistant's Nuki Matter page names the Go, Pro and Ultra; whether the standard 4th gen is covered is unconfirmed. Nuki also documents MQTT.

hubRequired.note: Nuki says the Matter lock needs no bridge or module. Remote access needs either a Nuki Bridge (sold separately) or the paid Thread remote-access option. Matter control needs a Thread border router.

localControl.note: No Nuki source describes offline or local-only control explicitly.

lockFit.note: Fits on the inside of the door over the existing cylinder, which keeps your keys. The Universal Cylinder is sold separately.

keypad.note: No keypad on the lock. Nuki sells the Keypad 2 NFC as a separate accessory.

power.note: Batteries included. Some press and retail text mentions a rechargeable pack, which the verifier should check.

summary: The Nuki Smart Lock (4th generation) is a retrofit lock that sits on the inside of a European door and speaks Matter over Thread, with no bridge needed for Matter. Nuki lists Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and SmartThings, and Home Assistant through Matter. Remote access needs a Nuki Bridge or Nuki's paid Thread remote-access option. It has no keypad of its own and runs on four AA batteries.
caveats: Matter control needs a Thread border router at home, such as a HomePod mini or Echo (4th Gen).
Remote access needs the separate Nuki Bridge or a one-time paid Thread remote-access option.
The Nuki Smart Lock Pro (4th generation) is a different model and not covered by this record.
Nuki's Matter hub table lists only the Echo (4th Gen) for Alexa over Thread.
